_note: v6.8: v6.3 with the CLIP member swapped: v11.3 (feature-GAN classifier on v10.3's LoRA features; validation HM 60.24% mean of 3 splits, test 64.9%: seen 60.9, unseen 69.5) + the same ConvNeXt as v6.3 (aniq_baseline_independent_convnext_base). Single change from v6.3 (v10.3 + ConvNeXt, validation HM 66.02%, test 74.99%). Motivation: v11.3 is stronger than v10.3 on seen (60.9 vs 55.1) but weaker on unseen, so it may complement the ConvNeXt differently. Same validation split as v6.3 (seed 42, one split = split 1 of v11.3's three); the ConvNeXt's validation scores are v6.3's cached file (same split, same scoring), v11.3's are produced by refitting its GAN + classifier on the split's fit images for its selected epoch (1), on v10.3's seed-42 split features. Decision rule: compare validation HM with v6.3 on the same split; keep only if more than 2 points better.
_result: Validation HM 68.81% (weight 0.4 on v11.3, gamma 5.4) vs v6.3 66.02% on the same split: +2.8, passes the 2-point rule (but inside the ~3-point run-to-run noise). Members alone on this split: v11.3 58.32% (reproduces its own split-1 58.27%), ConvNeXt 57.34%. Test (reported, not used to decide): HM 74.21% (seen 65.2, unseen 86.2) vs v6.3 74.99% (gamma 0: 29.58%).
title: convnext_v11.3_ensemble

ensemble._note: Weight on the first member (v11.3) from 0 to 1 in steps of 0.1; w = 1 is v11.3 alone, w = 0 ConvNeXt-Base alone.

validation._note: Same split as v6.3. gamma in log-probability units; the grid also goes down to -5 because v11.3 allows negative gamma (a classifier trained on synthetic unseen features can over-predict unseen pairs); otherwise as v6.3.
